coreValues.title: Equality
coreValues.text: We embrace diversity and make sure every child feels valued and included, whatever their background or ability.

coreValues.title: Integrity
coreValues.text: We are open and honest with families, and act with integrity in everything we do and say.

coreValues.title: Excellence
coreValues.text: We are committed to high-quality education and care, and we keep improving and bringing in new ideas.

coreValues.title: Practical learning
coreValues.text: Our activities build real-life skills such as problem-solving, communication and teamwork, preparing children for the challenges and successes ahead.

coreValues.title: Achieving goals
coreValues.text: We set achievable goals for each child, work together to reach them and celebrate every milestone, big or small.

coreValues.title: Interactive education
coreValues.text: Hands-on, interactive learning that sparks curiosity and a love of learning in every child.

approach.title: Foundational Development Program
approach.text: Goes beyond traditional preschool, laying the groundwork for essential life skills and preparing children for the world of tomorrow.

approach.title: Montessori-based learning
approach.text: Hands-on Montessori materials let children learn through their senses, at their own pace, and grow in independence.

approach.title: Thematic curriculum
approach.text: Each theme brings cognitive, language, personal, social, emotional and physical development together in one immersive experience.

approach.title: Visual, practical learning
approach.text: Children under five learn best by seeing and doing, so we teach practically, and what they learn visually stays with them.

facilities.title: Activity-based learning
facilities.text: A hands-on, Montessori-based approach to learning.

faqs.q: What age can my child join?
faqs.a: Children join the class that fits their age on 1 June: Play Group from 2 years, Nursery from 3, Junior KG from 4 and Senior KG from 5. Day care welcomes children from 2 to 8 years, with or without a Crossmaze class.
A Montessori-based, thematic curriculum: our Foundational Development Program, which brings language, numbers, social skills and physical development together in every theme.

Timings differ from branch to branch, and some programs run in more than one batch. You’ll find each branch’s programs, batches and timings on its page, under Branches. Day care follows on after class, so children can move from class straight into day care.

faqs.q: Do children bring their own food?
faqs.a: Yes. Children bring a packed snack from home, and children in day care bring a packed lunch too.

faqs.q: Can children from other schools join day care?
faqs.a: Yes. Day care is open to children up to 8 years from other schools. We collect them from the nearest drop point of their school bus.

faqs.q: Can I see my child during the day?
faqs.a: The Crossmaze Care parents’ app keeps every parent updated on their child’s day, and day care parents can also watch live on CCTV.
Yes. Our in-house transport runs on set routes within a 5 km radius of each centre. Seats depend on availability, so please check with your nearest centre.

faqs.q: How do I apply for admission?
faqs.a: Send us an enquiry, call us or message us on WhatsApp. Our admissions team will answer your questions and arrange a visit to your nearest centre, where you can meet the centre head and complete the admission.

dayRoutine.title: Good morning
dayRoutine.text: A warm welcome at the door, then circle time to say hello, share news and talk about the day.

dayRoutine.title: Montessori work time
dayRoutine.text: Hands-on materials for language, numbers and practical life, explored at each child’s own pace.

dayRoutine.title: Snack and stories
dayRoutine.text: Snack time together, followed by stories, rhymes and plenty of conversation.

dayRoutine.title: Theme activities
dayRoutine.text: Art and craft, music and show-and-tell, all built around the theme of the week.

dayRoutine.title: Play and movement
dayRoutine.text: Indoor and outdoor play, dance and yoga to build strength, balance and confidence.

dayRoutine.title: Day care afternoon
dayRoutine.text: Day care children have lunch, a rest in the nap room and calm afternoon activities until pick-up.
